name: Neural Transient Fields (NeTF)
definition: A method for Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS) imaging that models the plenoptic transient field using a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) to predict transient arrival times τ(x, y, t) from sparse SPAD measurements on a relay wall.
summary: Neural Transient Fields is a non-line-of-sight imaging method using an MLP to predict transient arrival times from sparse SPAD measurements, distinguishing itself by handling occlusion and sampling bias unlike standard NeRF.
